codecSource: local source corresponding to npm tabwerk-session-codec@0.1.0; no registry install
scope: Synthetic chronological saved-autosave export arrays. Not Garrison whole-database captures, extension performance, or external adoption.

measurements.sizes: Retained logical bytes, including every format header and all manifests/blocks. Not filesystem allocated blocks.
measurements.writePayload: Sum of emitted payload lengths across append operations; modeled writes, excludes disk I/O/fsync. Codec is a rewritten standalone JSON container, not an implemented append-only block store.
measurements.timings: Sequential local Node, warmed implementations, rotated method order per round. Include serialization/compression or parsing/decompression; exclude assertions and disk I/O. Not browser timings.
measurements.restore: One target point from an already memory-resident compressed byte buffer. Entire codec JSON is parsed each time; ZIP-rollup extracts only target entry.
